profile.purpose: isolated Qwen Image 2.1 Turbo comparison using the designed eight-step explicit sigma profile and original synchronous static memory policy; same INT8 text encoder and BF16 VAE
profile.synthetic_prompt: A blue butterfly resting on a red flower, soft daylight.

comparison_scope: Turbo BF16 DiT, eight explicit-sigma Euler steps, same INT8 text encoder and BF16 VAE; static synchronous source memory policy. Not an all-BF16 or general Stage 2 acceptance claim.
quality_observation: Identical Rust/Python pixels. Turbo has resolved wing scales/veins and fine pale fringes, a dense red cone-shaped flower center and darker olive background. Composition/flower differ from preserved forty-step standard checkpoints; one synthetic prompt/seed does not rank general quality.
